title: Local Business Digital Marketing That Scales Growth | Click Here Digital

facts.fact: Click Here Digital states it has over 30 years of experience.
facts.quote: With over 30 years of experience, we’ve built a reputation for helping businesses of all sizes thrive

facts.fact: Click Here Digital states it is trusted by hundreds of SMBs (vendor's own claim, not independently verified).
facts.quote: trusted by hundreds of SMBs to deliver real, measurable results.

facts.fact: Click Here Digital is based in Baton Rouge, and states its clients span the entire country.
facts.quote: While we proudly call Baton Rouge home, our clients span the entire country.

facts.fact: Click Here Digital describes its core services as search engine optimization (SEO), paid search, social media, and programmatic advertising, with a stated focus on small and mid-sized local businesses.
facts.quote: From search engine optimization (SEO) and paid search to social media and programmatic advertising

facts.fact: Click Here Digital lists home services, retail & eCommerce, local restaurants and hospitality, and professional services among the industries it has worked with.
facts.quote: A few of the industries we’ve worked with:

facts.fact: Click Here Digital's proprietary ClickIQ platform is described as tracking website traffic, leads, calls, store visits, and sales in real time.
facts.quote: Track your website traffic, leads, calls, store visits, and sales—all in real time

facts.fact: Click Here Digital's ClickIQ reporting is described as consolidating data from platforms including Google Ads, Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, Bing, and TikTok, plus others.
facts.quote: Our insights eliminate the need to log into multiple, separate platforms - Google Ads, Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, Bing, TikTok and more
